leadText:
Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪ (Japanese: チャモチャモ☆ぷりてぃ) is a series by the author Yumi Tsukirino, and is a sequel to Magical Pokémon Journey.

The series is a comedy-styled manga which follows the adventures of as she attempts to win over her crush, , whom she meets after moving with her Trainer from the city to a small town. and reappear as supporting characters, as well as new friends , , and Chiru-Chiru. Chapters commonly focus on coming-of-age themes such as friendship and having crushes, yet retain the zany sense of humor seen in the manga's predecessor. 

This manga features Generation III Pokémon, and used to run in Ciao.

==Gallery==
 
Chamochamopretty_logo.png|Logo
 

==Trivia==
Similar to Magical Pokémon Journey, it is common in this manga for Pokémon to speak the human language.
Volumes frequently contain personality quizzes that assign the reader to a character from the series.
Magical Pokémon Journey's "Pokémon File" continues in this manga, as well as the frequent appearances of Yumi Tsukirino's author avatar to discuss her experiences of writing the series and playing .
